Well, how are they not falling over?|Gregor|Will you look at the size of those things!|Rex|Reinforced armor plating, heavy cannons and antipersonnel blasters.|Ezra|I'm glad you guys are so excited, but those giant death machines are on their way to blow us to bits!|attr=Clone Wars veterans and Jedi Padawan Ezra Bridger encounter AT-AT/Ps on Seelos|src=}} The '''All Terrain Armored Transport (Prototype)''', or '''AT-AT/P''' or simply '''AT-AT''', was the original model of combat [[walker]] [[transport]] used by the [[Imperial Army]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] throughout the [[Imperial Era]]. It was one of several different models produced by [[Kuat Drive Yards]] prior to the release of the standard [[All Terrain Armored Transport (Galactic Civil War)|All Terrain Armored Transport]]. ==Characteristics== {{Quote|Listen. Those walkers double as troop transports so once you get inside... be careful.|Cere Junda, warning Cal Kestis as he embarked to steal an AT-AT/P in active combat|}} The All Terrain Armored Transport (Prototype), or AT-AT/P, was a prototype model of [[AT-series]] [[walker]]. was pitted against rebels during the [[early rebellion against the Galactic Empire]]. Manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards]], the AT-AT/P was the successor of the [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] (AT-TE) that saw use during the [[Clone Wars]].{{SWE|technology|attewalker|AT-TE walker}} The Imperial AT-AT/P was armed with two heavy [[laser cannon]] [[turret]]s, four anti-personnel [[blaster]]s, and a dorsal twin [[laser]] turret at the rear. A [[Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti''-class cruiser]] was capable of carrying two AT-AT/P.{{Rebels|A Princess on Lothal}} A single [[walker]] was operated by two [[AT-AT pilot|AT-AT drivers]], who [[pilot]]ed the machinery alongside an optional [[vehicle commander]]. [[File:ProtoATATCockpit.png|thumb|left|224px|A walker was manned by two AT-AT/P pilots based in the [[cockpit]].]] Many [[Commanding officer|commanders]] placed the AT-AT/P at the forefront of battle, though some sent [[All Terrain Defense Pod]]s (AT-DPs) to operate alongside the hulking{{Rebels|An Inside Man}}{{Rebels|Jedi Night}} combat walker The Imperial [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] had his AT-AT/P walkers flanked by [[K79-S80 Imperial Troop Transport|Imperial Troop Transports]] and [[stormtrooper]]s.{{Rebels|Zero Hour}} The AT-AT/P was larger than the [[All Terrain Armored Transport (Galactic Civil War)|later AT-AT model]] used during the [[Galactic Civil War]],[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] which measured twenty- and twenty-two point five [[meter]]s in length and height respectively.''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: AT-ACT Deluxe Book and 3D Wood Model]]''{{SWE|technology|atatwalker|All Terrain Armored Transport}} However, as with the later model,{{Film|V}} its [[Limb|legs]] were attenuated as with other walkers such as the AT-TE or AT-DP,''[[Star Wars: Commander]]'' allowing the early walker model to be exploitable by [[lightsaber]] strikes and, in one instance,{{Film|V}} [[magnetic harpoon]]s''[[The Adventures of Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight]]'' that tripped the entire walker and exposed its vulnerable neck to laser [[cannon]]{{SWE|technology|snowspeeder|snowspeeder}} or [[Mass-driver cannon|heavy projectile cannon]]{{Databank|at-te-walker|AT-TE Walker}} fire that severely damaged the vehicle. ==History== ===Development=== The AT-AT/P walker was developed from the Clone Wars-era AT-TE for use in the Imperial [[Army]], the ground forces of the Galactic Empire. The AT-AT/P constituted a far more imposing example of walker technology than its predecessor; it featured long legs that lifted the narrow body of the vehicle which towered over the AT-TE as well as the [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]]'s deep [[Water|rivers]], superseding the Clone Wars vehicle's six stubby legs whose movements were hindered by obstacles of a comparable height.{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}} The walker was in service by the time of the [[Invasion of Mon Cala]] in [[18 BBY]].[[Darth Vader (2017) 14|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 14]] ===Early rebellion against the Empire=== ====Kashyyyk==== {{Quote|Hey! Who are you?''"
"''Someone who just brought an AT-AT to the table. Who are you?''"
"''Someone making the Empire angry. We're advancing on the Imp landing pad up ahead, wouldn't mind fire support.''"
"''Copy that. Let's make 'em even angrier.|Saw Gerrera and Cal Kestis|}} [[File:AT-AT-P.Cal_Kestis.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Cal Kestis prepares to infiltrate an AT-AT/P traversing a body of water.]] In [[14 BBY]], several AT-AT/Ps were stationed on Kashyyyk and were deployed to assist in defending an [[Imperial Refinery]] against [[Saw Gerrera]] and his [[Partisans]]. One found itself collapsed cockpit-first over the edge of the [[Kyyyalstaad Falls]] near the [[Imperial Refinery]]. The [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Cal Kestis]] successfully infiltrated and hijacked an AT-AT/P, and used it to help Partisans capture a landing area by eliminating Imperial forces along the way to it. The hijacked AT-AT/P fell after Kestis used it to take down a [[Zeta-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle|''Zeta''-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle]], which crashed into the AT-AT/P while falling. When Imperial reinforcements arrived, the Partisans were forced to retreat. Gerrera shot down an AT-AT/P during the retreat. ==== Jedha ==== In [[9 BBY]], several AT-AT/Ps were deployed by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] and the [[Inquisitorius]] against the assault on the [[Hidden Path]]'s secret lair on [[Jedha]] after [[Bode Akuna]] leaked ISB Commander [[Lank Denvik]]'s intel when they were about to move the under repair [[Jedi Archives]] to [[Tanalorr]]. They were destroyed by [[Cere Junda]], though she was later killed by Vader in a fierce duel, while the Archives were destroyed by the Sith Lord. ====The Spectres==== =====Warring walkers===== {{Quote|Those things are practically impervious to blasters, but they have one weak point in their armor, the neck.''"
"''One well placed shot from the main gun should destroy it.|Sabine Wren and Clone Commando Gregor|}} In [[4 BBY]], [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] led three AT-AT/P walkers on an [[Assault on Seelos|assault]] on the desert planet of [[Seelos]] against the [[Spectres]]. The rebel group was meeting with the [[Exile (punishment)|exiled]] [[Clone trooper officer|clone officers]] [[Rex]], [[Wolffe]], and [[Gregor]], aboard [[Rex's AT-TE|their]] modified All Terrain Tactical Enforcer.{{Databank|modified-at-te-walker|Modified AT-TE Walker}} Ultimately, all the Imperial walkers were lost to the rebels, and one of them was later repurposed by the [[Cloning|clones]] as [[Joopa Base]], their mobile camp.{{Databank|joopa-base|Joopa Base}} =====Platform patrol===== {{Quote|Gravity locks? This is hardly necessary.''"
"''I insist. Plus a trooper detachment, and for extra security... Walkers will guard your ships from the rebel insurgency. All for your saftey, miss.''"
"''It's ''Your Highness.''|Princess Leia Organa and Imperial Lieutenant Yogar Lyste|}} [[File:Gozanti_with_AT-ATs.png|thumb|left|230px|A ''Gozanti''-class cruiser deploys two AT-AT/Ps to patrol the Lothal landing platform.]] AT-AT/Ps were used again in [[3 BBY]] against the Spectres, when [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] arrived on the planet to give the ''[[Ghost]]''{{'s}} crew three [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvettes]]. Two walkers were deployed to patrol the transports' landing platform, which were formally on Lothal to offer supplies to citizens impacted by the rebel efforts. When the rebels [[Mission on Lothal|tried to steal]] the corvettes, the ''Ghost'' started firing on the AT-AT/Ps. Four [[proton torpedo]]s were not powerful enough to destroy one of the walkers, and it was necessary for [[Kanan Jarrus]] to use his [[Kanan Jarrus' lightsaber|lightsaber]] to cut its legs, toppling it. The second one was knocked down by the engines of the last corvette, piloted by [[Ryder Azadi]]. =====Armory attack===== {{Quote|Grand Admiral, there is a small band of rebels attacking the east gate. I've deployed two AT-ATs. Should I send backup?''"
"''Yes, Lieutenant. Let's play their game.|Imperial Lieutenant Yogar Lyste and Grand Admiral Thrawn|}} In [[2 BBY]], [[Lieutenant]] [[Yogar Lyste]] deployed two AT-AT/P walkers, [[Walker 271]] and [[Walker 414]], to combat an attack on the east gate of the [[Imperial Armory Complex]] by members of the [[Lothal resistance group]] led by Ryzder Azadi. The rebels Kanan, [[Ezra Bridger]], and [[C1-10P|Chopper]] escaped in the stolen AT-DP [[Walker 216]]. However, Grand [[Admiral]] Thrawn realized that the rebels had hijacked the AT-DP walker and ordered his AT-AT/Ps to crush them. One of the AT-AT/P walkers proceeded to crush the AT-DP under its heavy body but the rebels managed to use their lightsabers to cut their way aboard. [[Marida Sumar]] also fired a rocket which hit one of the walker's legs. After knocking out the AT-AT pilots, the two climbed out and escaped with Ryder's cell into the wilderness. =====Battle of Atollon===== {{Quote|I know that sound.''"
"''Yeah. And I hate that sound.''"
"''Lousy four-leggers.''"
"''Hit 'em with the detonators.|Captain Rex and Garazeb Orrelios|}} [[File:Bendu_lighting_form.jpg|thumb|right|240px|AT-AT/Ps shifted their cockpits upwards to take down the airborne Bendu]] Thrawn then deployed six of these during the [[Battle of Atollon|battle]] on [[Atollon]]. Jarrus destroyed one with his lightsaber. The [[Force wielder]] [[Bendu]] then destroyed three of the AT-AT/P walkers, though the last two were able to shoot him down from the [[Atmosphere|sky]]. =====Jedi Knight===== {{Quote|Governor Pryce, the rebels are headed for the fuel depot.''"
"''I'll mobilize walkers, We'll trap them there.|Rukh and Governor Pryce|}} The walkers were later used by [[Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]] on Lothal during the [[Rescue of Hera Syndulla (Lothal)|rescue of Hera Syndulla]]. As Kanan Jarrus and [[Hera Syndulla]] were about to be picked up by Bridger and [[Sabine Wren]] atop of the [[Lothal City fuel depot]],{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/jedi-night-episode-guide|text="Jedi Night" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} two AT-AT/Ps approached, and were commanded by Pryce to open fire on the [[fuel pod]]s. An AT-AT/P pilot questioned this, referring to the highly volatile [[fuel]] contained within the pods. Despite this, Pryce insisted upon her orders; the walkers fired, causing an [[Fire|explosion]], thus forcing Jarrus to use [[the Force]] in an effort to save the other rebels. In sacrifice, the Jedi pushed Syndulla into Bridger and Wren's awaiting [[gunship]], preventing the harm of others as he himself was consumed in the ensuing flames. In the aftermath of this incident, Grand Admiral Thrawn viewed Pryce's actions as a mistake as it destroyed the Empire's entire fuel supply on Lothal for his [[TIE/D Defender Elite|TIE Defender project]].{{Rebels|DUME}} Before the [[Liberation of Lothal]], the ''[[Ghost]]'' visited the walker [[Joopa Base]] on [[Seelos]].{{Rebels|A Fool's Hope}} ===New Republic=== Despite their Galactic Civil War counterparts being more prominent in the Empire's failed war to stop the Rebellion from reviving the Republic, several AT-AT/Ps were present alongside several Stormtroopers and [[Cold weather assault trooper|Snowtroopers]] on an ice mountain world.{{SWYouTube|_pa1KLXuW0Y|The Mandalorian and Grogu | Official Trailer | In Theaters May 22, 2026}} ==Behind the scenes== The design of the All Terrain Armored Transport in ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' is taken from early illustrations produced for [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] by [[Joe Johnston]] and [[Ralph McQuarrie]]. In particular, the early-[[1978]] [[:File:ATAT JoeJohnston.jpg|Johnston sketch]] and McQuarrie's early-[[1982]] [[:File:ATAT RM.jpg|illustration]].{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/relics-of-the-old-republic-trivia-gallery|text="Relics of the Old Republic" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 5}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of All Terrain Armored Transports (early rebellion against the Empire)}} *''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'' *''[[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor]]'' *{{Rebels|Relics of the Old Republic}} {{1st}} *{{RebelsMagCite|17|Vulnerable Areas}} *{{Rebels|A Princess on Lothal}} *{{Rebels|The Last Battle}} *{{RebelsAnimationCite|1|A Trooper's Worth}} *{{Rebels|An Inside Man}} *{{Rebels|Zero Hour}} *{{Rebels|Jedi Night}} *{{Rebels|DUME}} {{Wreck}} *{{Rebels|A World Between Worlds}} {{C|Sound only}} *{{Rebels|A Fool's Hope}} *''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu]]'' ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars Rebels: Visual Guide: Epic Battles]]'' *{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Black Series|pack=#031: AT-AT Driver|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/AT-AT-Pilot-Driver-31-Star-Wars-The-Black-Series-6-inch.asp}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Walkers and Ground Vehicles of the Empire and First Order}} *{{SW|url=news/swca-2022-star-wars-jedi-survivor-interview|text=SWCA 2022: Respawn's Stig Asmussen Talks ''Star Wars Jedi: Survivor'' and Reflects on Its Predecessor – Exclusive}} *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|"All Terrain Armored Transport (Prototype)" and "AT-AT/P"}} *{{Databank|joopa-base|Joopa Base}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=全地形対応装甲トランスポート（試作型） |ko=AT-AT 시제기 }} [[Category:AT-series models|Armored Transport 1]] [[Category:Kuat Drive Yards products]] [[Category:Vehicle classes of the Galactic Empire]]
